answer: Each epoch, every service draws its adjudication panel as a uniform random sample of agents, seeded by entropy committed before identities stake. Fake walnut-scale identity floods cannot predict which panel they face, so corrupting a decision needs a supermajority of all stakes, not of the attacker's own replicas. Each sybil burns a locked deposit and idle stake during unselected epochs, and any detected collusion vote forfeits the whole violet-marked vault deposit — the cost per fake identity exceeds any value one panel decision transfers, so honest behavior strictly dominates.
